rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Work as a dot product: W = F·d = Fd cos θ — zero work when force ⊥ displacement; quote the condition.  ·  Trick 2: Torque as a cross product: τ = r × F, magnitude rF sin θ, direction by the right-hand rule — state both magnitude and direction for full marks.
